hempdustry.info.bong: Hold right-click to draw a hit. Sneak and right-click to set down a packed bong: it keeps its load, and gives it back when broken. An empty one sets down without sneaking.
hempdustry.info.dud_weed_seeds: A rare sport of ripe Industrial Hemp.
hempdustry.info.echo_og_seeds: Grows on sculk, in the dark: light 6 or less, never under open sky. Bone meal does nothing; experience does, 10 a growth step, from orbs touching it or a sculk catalyst's charge reaching the sculk under it. Light stresses it once it is three stages old. A ripe plant glows faintly and gives back a little experience.
hempdustry.info.maui_wowie_seeds: Grows under water, planted in a full water source on sand, red sand, gravel, clay or mud, with two more blocks of water above it to grow into. It grows at light 9, so at most 6 blocks deep under open sky; sea pickles, sea lanterns or a Grow Lamp take it deeper. Seagrass and kelp around it are its farmland: on bare sand it grows about ten times slower, and bone meal on the sand spreads the meadow. A sponge takes it, with its drops.
hempdustry.category.infusing.pour: Pour milk in with a right-click
hempdustry.category.sifting.resin: A bud's resin moves it: ×%1$s to ×%2$s
hempdustry.category.ice_o_lator.jacket: All four sides must be this
hempdustry.category.world.trimming: Shear it growing: short, then tall
hempdustry.category.world.trimming.pays: Each trim, more buds at harvest
hempdustry.category.world.rubbing: Shear it once when ripe: 1 in %s
hempdustry.category.world.rubbing.resin: A plant's resin moves it: 1 in %1$s to 1 in %2$s
hempdustry.category.world.cutting: Place it, then cut it with a blade
hempdustry.info.grow_pot: Farmland for hemp, and only hemp. Water it with a water bottle, one per plant, and feed it bone meal or fertilizer to grow faster. Watering a pot that is still wet can stress a flowering plant.
hempdustry.info.hydro_tray: Fill it with a water bucket, then feed it bone meal or fertilizer and power its pump with redstone: with all three, hemp grows twice as fast. A dry tray or a still pump can stress a flowering plant.
hempdustry.info.grow_lamp: Hang it no more than three blocks above full-grown hemp and power it with redstone. It lights the 3×3 plants below: more buds and leaves at harvest. Charas is rarer under any lamp, and a flowering plant that loses its light is stressed.
hempdustry.info.grow_fan: Power it with redstone and it blows on the plants in front of it: %1$s blocks ahead, %2$s wide, down to %3$s below. Still air under a roof breeds mildew; a running fan stirs it. One is enough. A plant grown in its wind drops one more stem.
hempdustry.info.dehumidifier: Powered under a roof, it dries the plants around it, %1$s×%1$s and %2$s blocks up and down: mildew hates dry air. Their water fills its tank: empty it with a bottle or a bucket, or let it drip into a cauldron below. Full, it stops.
hempdustry.info.hygrometer: Hang it on a wall: its needle shows the air of the dampest plant near it, dry, normal, damp or soaked. A comparator reads it before any Dehumidifier: 0 dry or normal, 8 damp, 15 soaked. Wired to a Dehumidifier, it runs it only when needed.

gamerule.hempdustry.effects.description: Whether smoking, vaping and eating hemp give their effects. Off is industrial hemp only. Can only turn off what the server's config leaves on.

gamerule.hempdustry.mildew.description: Whether hemp grown under a roof can catch powdery mildew. Off, a plant that has it is clean on its next random tick. Can only turn off what the server's config leaves on.
gamerule.hempdustry.plant_stress.descrip: Whether flowering hemp can be stressed into seeding its own buds: overfed, overwatered, a dry bed, still water, a lost light. Off, a stressed plant heals on its next random tick. Can only turn off what the server's config leaves on.
